# runpod_user (Data Source)

The account the API key belongs to. Deprecated: There is no REST v2 account identity route yet; this data source reads the account through the GraphQL myself query (REST v1 /user is gone from the v1 host) and will be removed when a /v2 account surface exists. Only id and email have a GraphQL source; the other attributes read null.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_user" "this" {}

# Only id and email have a GraphQL source; the 1.x quota, key, name, verified and
# cloud-tier attributes read null.
output "account_email" {
  description = "Email of the account the API key belongs to."
  value       = data.runpod_user.this.email
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
use-case modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides
section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud_type` (String) Default cloud tier for the account. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `email` (String) Account email address, from the GraphQL myself query.
- `gpu_limit` (Number) Maximum number of GPUs the account may run. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `gpu_usage` (Number) GPUs the account is currently running. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `id` (String) Account identifier, from the GraphQL myself query.
- `name` (String) Account holder name. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `pub_key` (String) Public SSH key registered on the account. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field. The v2 SSH keys route serves the registered keys.
- `storage_limit` (Number) Maximum storage the account may allocate, in GB. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `storage_usage` (Number) Storage the account currently allocates, in GB. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
- `verified` (Boolean) Whether the account email is verified. Always null: the GraphQL account read has no such field.
